name: phase spider
desc: Phase Spider is a CR 3 monstrosity.

actions.name: ethereal sight
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can see 60 feet into the Ethereal Plane when it is on the Material Plane.

actions.name: spider climb
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can climb difficult surfaces, including along ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

actions.name: web walker
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} ignores movement restrictions caused by webs, and the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} knows the location of any other creature in contact with the same web.

actions.name: bite
actions.desc: [[/attack extended]]. [[/damage average extended]]. If this damage reduces the target to 0 Hit Points, the target becomes Stable, and it has the &Reference[Poisoned apply=false] condition for 1 hour. While Poisoned, the target also has the &Reference[Paralyzed apply=false] condition.

actions.name: ethereal jaunt
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} teleports from the Material Plane to the Ethereal Plane or vice versa.
